svg.aria-label: Animated diagram of fin-primitives turning trades into candles. Twenty-four real ETH-USD ticks from the candles example land on a price and time chart split into one-minute buckets. Each tick goes through OhlcvAggregator::push_tick, which returns an empty Vec while the tick stays in the current bucket and returns the finished bar when a tick opens the next bucket: the 15:00 bar closes at open 3186.17, high 3190.94, low 3182.16, close 3190.94 from 12 ticks. Finished bars feed indicators through Signal::update; RSI(14) returns Unavailable for bars 1 to 14 and its first value, 71.72, on bar 15.
svg.text: How trades become candles and indicators
24 real ticks from cargo run --example candles, one-minute bars, replayed

g.text: tick absorbed: the open bar's high, low, close and volume update

svg.text: A tick for the next bucket closes the bar. Empty buckets in between come back as gap-fill bars with zero volume.
Finished bars feed indicators: rsi.update(&BarInput::from(&bar)) -> SignalValue
bar 15 (15:14): Scalar(71.72), then a value every bar
No NaN and no zero-fill while an indicator warms up: RSI(14) needs 15 bars, so it says so.
Same types for 700+ indicators, the order book, the position ledger and the risk monitor.
